note: P4271 (Pro 25:22) — for you heap burning coals on his head, and the LORD will reward you.

dims.v: divine recompense — God rewards kindness shown to an enemy
the reward the LORD gives to the one who feeds his enemy — divine recompense crowning the mercy that returns good for evil
the divine reward that answers mercy toward a foe

shalam (repay/reward) — 'and the LORD will REWARD you'; God himself recompenses the one who shows kindness to an enemy (the 'burning coals' melting him to shame or repentance). Locus external:god — the divine reward that makes enemy-love wisdom, not weakness (cf Rom 12:20-21).
